summary: Union County cab described as built in the 1930s; a 1933 newspaper item names a Summit Springs station completed in 1932; now gone per FFLOS and firelookout.com.

facts.status_note: Cab now gone per FFLOS and firelookout.com; one Oregon lookouts list marks it removed.

events.note: Newspaper item of January 7, 1933 lists a fire lookout station at Summit Springs among 1932 projects; the item does not name the cab
Panorama photos taken at Summit Springs (September 1935 entry)

evidence.supports: cab built in the 1930s, D-5 13 by 13 feet, now gone
evidence.quote: Built in the 1930s, this D-5 13'x13' cab is now gone.

evidence.supports: newspaper item: fire lookout station at Summit Springs, projects completed in 1932
evidence.quote: Projects completed during the year (1932) include a fire lookout station at Summit Springs.

evidence.supports: newspaper source named as La Grande Evening Observer, dated January 7, 1933
September 1935 panorama photos at Summit Springs
list marks the lookout as removed
administered by the U.S. Forest Service

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and firelookout.com say the 1930s; the newspaper item gives 1932. The dates fit together, but the newspaper does not name this cab, so linking the station to the cab is an inference.

notes_for_editor: The 1932 build year rests on one newspaper item quoted on the oregonlookouts list; the FFLOS pages say only 1930s. The original La Grande Evening Observer item was not checked (Historic Oregon Newspapers may hold it). FFLOS photo captions (1942 and a 2009 site photo) were not added; the 2009 caption does not say what remains. No staffing, fire or site-today sources found. Brief record has no errors to correct.
